name: jevflow
description: Lightweight YAML single judgments and decision flows for Jev.

interface.shortDescription: 编排和执行轻量 Jev 决策流程
interface.longDescription: Agent edits YAML policies; the bundled Python runtime validates, snapshots and executes typed Jev decisions. Hosts own data preparation, scheduling and actions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use jevflow to inspect or create a YAML decision policy, validate it and test its routes.
